import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetics for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Initialize the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', style='BMI Category', 
                 palette='deep', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and BMI Category', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Legend', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
